crossRefs.note: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift…
He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes…
but to Hannah he gave a double portion, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.
Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those…
Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
translations.bsb: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
translations.kjv: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry
translations.asv: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
